definition: The Moon's phase (its angle to the Sun) sets the timing tone of a day: when to initiate, build, culminate, or release. It pairs with the cyclic waxing/waning model.

new.range: conjunction to ~45 deg ahead of Sun
new.tone: Initiate, plant, begin. Instinctive, low-visibility starts.

waxing.tone: Build, develop, push forward. Effort and growth.

full.tone: Culminate, reveal, harvest. Peak visibility and emotion; results show.

waning.tone: Release, distribute, complete, rest. Wind down and let go.

voidOfCourse.definition: The Moon makes no more major aspects before leaving its current sign.
voidOfCourse.effect: A poor window to initiate; plans started now tend to fizzle. Good only for routine, rest, and finishing.
voidOfCourse.appUsage: Flag void-of-course periods as a do-not-launch window and steer the daily advice toward maintenance over initiation.

appUsage: Gate 'initiate vs release' advice by phase: push new ventures while waxing, complete and let go while waning. Treat the full Moon as a reveal/peak, the new Moon as a reset.
summary: The Moon phase sets timing tone for initiation, growth, culmination, release, and void-of-course caution.
